\"\n                    f\"full artifact: {path.resolve()}]\")\n    source = html.escape(path.stem, quote=True)\n    return f'<evidence source=\"{source}\">\\n{content}\\n</evidence>'\n            \"commands_parallel\": self.commands_parallel,\n            \"verify_experiment\": self.verify_experiment,\n            \"command_timeout\": self.command_timeout,\n            \"command_output_max_bytes\": self.command_output_max_bytes,\n            \"cwd\": self.cwd,\n            \"git_commit\": self.git_commit,\n            \"commit_message\": self.commit_message,\n        }\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Pipeline:\n    \"\"\"Multi-stage pipeline definition.\"\"\"\n    stages: list[Stage] = field(default_factory=list)\n    decision_log: str = \"\"  # append structured decisions per finished stage\n    archive_dir: str = \"\"  # move completed deliverables here after a successful run\n    name: str = \"pipeline\"  # label for archive subdirectories\n    \n    def to_dict(self):\n        return {\"stages\": [s.to_dict() for s in self.stages]}\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Task:\n    \"\"\"A single pi invocation task.\"\"\"\n\n    prompt: str\n    output: str = \"\"\n    model: str = AGENT_DEFAULT_MODEL\n    provider: str = \"\"\n    thinking: str = \"\"\n    tools: str = \"\"\n    exclude_tools: str = \"\"\n    cwd: str = \"\"\n    timeout: int = AGENT_DEFAULT_TIMEOUT\n    env: dict = field(default_factory=dict)\n    validate: Optional[str] = None  # per-task engineering gate; None = inherit, \"\" = disabled\n    memory: dict = field(default_factory=dict)  # stage/role/task metadata for the memory index\n\n    def to_cmd(self, session_flags: Optional[list] = None) -> list[str]:\n        return config.build_agent_argv(\n            config.AGENT_BIN, self.prompt, model=self.model,\n            provider=self.provider, thinking=self.thinking, tools=self.tools,\n            exclude_tools=self.exclude_tools, session_flags=session_flags)\n\n    def workdir(self) -> str:\n        return self.cwd or os.getcwd()\n\n    def output_path(self) -> Optional[Path]:\n        \"\"\"Resolve the output path. Relative outputs resolve against the\n        task's cwd (where the agent actually runs), not the process cwd.\n\n        Local fix (self-iteration round 1): previously resolved against the\n        process cwd, silently writing deliverables to the wrong directory\n        whenever task.cwd was set.\n        \"\"\"\n        if not self.output:\n            return None\n        p = Path(self.output)\n        if not p.is_absolute():\n            p = Path(self.cwd or os.getcwd()) / p\n        return p.resolve()\n\n    def resolve_prompt(self, base_dir: str = \"\") -> str:\n        \"\"\"Resolve @file references in the prompt to file contents.\n\n        Supports:\n          @file.md              -> loads file.md content\n          @docs/analysis.md     -> loads docs/analysis.md\n          prefix text @file.md  -> prepends file content before prefix text\n\n        Returns the resolved prompt string.\n        \"\"\"\n        def replace(match: re.Match) -> str:\n            fpath = Path(match.group(1))\n            if not fpath.is_absolute():\n                fpath = Path(base_dir) / fpath\n            if not fpath.is_file():\n                raise ValueError(f\"prompt reference not found: {fpath}\")\n            return read_text_bounded(fpath, config.INPUT_MAX_BYTES,\n                                     \"prompt reference\")\n\n        # Only path-like references with a known extension are resolved so\n        # that event versions like vault.file.deleted@1.1 stay literal.\n        return re.sub(r\"@((?:[\\w./-]+/)*[\\w.-]+\\.(?:md|txt|ya?ml|json))\",\n                      replace, self.prompt)\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass TaskResult:\n    task: Task\n    success: bool\n    stdout: str = \"\"\n    stderr: str = \"\"\n    elapsed: float = 0.0\n    returncode: int = -1\n    reason: str = \"\"\n    # T2 (full-SDLC pipeline): additive validator-outcome fields, populated\n    # when the engineering gate ran against the artifact. Empty/None defaults\n    # keep every existing serializer and consumer compatible.\n    validation_ok: Optional[bool] = None\n    validation_exit: int = 0\n    validation_stderr: str = \"\"\n    session_id: str = \"\"\n    # True when stdout/stderr were already shown live. This prevents the\n    # stdout-only shortcut from printing a successful answer a second time.\n    streamed_output: bool = False\n    session_name: str = \"\"\n    raw_session: str = \"\"\n    # Execution trace fields.  They are additive and remain empty for\n    # synthetic/reused results that did not invoke the runner.\n    run_id: str = \"\"\n    task_id: str = \"\"\n    stage_id: str = \"\"\n    attempt: int = 0\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}
{"type":"item.completed","item":{"id":"item_6","type":"command_execution","command":"/usr/local/bin/zsh -lc \"sed -n '1,150p' pbatch/lock.py && sed -n '190,390p' pbatch/runner.py\"","aggregated_output":"\"\"\"Single-instance lock (R4 / T4, 7x24 governance).\n\nA second pi-batch process must not run against the same worktree: two\nround loops would double-spend quota and interleave session writes. The\nlock is an O_EXCL-published file `.pi-batch.lock` in the process cwd\nholding {pid, start, host, argv, token} JSON.\n\nContract (hardened after the round-4 adversarial reviews):\n\n- **Atomic publication**: the payload is written to a unique temp file\n  and linked into place (`os.link`), so no reader can ever observe an\n  empty/partial lock file (a non-atomic write + separate O_EXCL create\n  let a second instance break a lock that was still being born).\n- **Stale = dead PID only**: a lock whose holder PID is alive is refused\n  (exit 5) regardless of age. Live locks are NEVER broken on age alone —\n  the tool's flagship mode is `--max-rounds 0` 7x24 runs that routinely\n  exceed 24h, and breaking a live lock displaces a running instance into\n  split-brain. Only a lock whose holder is dead (crash/SIGKILL) is broken.\n- **Fail closed on unparseable locks**: an unreadable/empty lock file is\n  refused (a partial write under the old format is never \"free to take\").\n- **Ownership-checked release**: `release_lock` unlinks the path only\n  when the file still carries this process's token — a foreign (successor)\n  lock is left in place.\n- **Round re-verification**: `verify_held` lets the round loop confirm\n  the lock is still ours between rounds; a lock that vanished (unlinked\n  by a concurrent breaker) stops the instance with exit 5 instead of\n  continuing in split-brain.\n- The file is 0o600 and the `-p`/`--prompt` value is redacted from the\n  recorded argv (prompt content is sensitive and the file can survive a\n  SIGKILL).\n\nReleased in finally; skipped for --dry-run; --no-lock is the documented\nescape hatch.\n\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport json\nimport os\nimport sys\nimport tempfile\nimport time\nimport uuid\nfrom pathlib import Path\nfrom typing import Optional\n\nfrom .config import log\n\nLOCK_NAME = \".pi-batch.lock\"\nSTALE_AGE_SEC = 24 * 3600\nLOCK_EXIT_CODE = 5  # new exit-code contract (docs/RUNNING_247.md)\n\n# token -> lock path, per process: release/verify must only ever touch\n# locks this process actually created (a successor's file is never ours).\n_OWNED: dict = {}\n\n\ndef _alive(pid: int) -> bool:\n    try:\n        os.kill(pid, 0)\n        return True\n    except (ProcessLookupError, PermissionError):\n        return False\n\n\ndef _redacted_argv(argv: list) -> str:\n    \"\"\"sys.argv for the lock payload with prompt values redacted: the lock\n    file is world-listed and can survive a SIGKILL, so `-p SECRET` must not\n    land in it. Values following -p/--prompt are replaced; other flags are\n    kept verbatim.\"\"\"\n    out = []\n    i = 0\n    while i < len(argv):\n        arg = argv[i]\n        out.append(arg)\n        if arg in (\"-p\", \"--prompt\") and i + 1 < len(argv):\n            out.append(\"[redacted]\")\n            i += 1\n        i += 1\n    return \" \".join(out)\n\n\ndef _payload(cwd: str) -> dict:\n    return {\n        \"pid\": os.getpid(),\n        \"start\": time.time(),\n        \"host\": os.uname().nodename,\n        \"argv\": _redacted_argv(sys.argv),\n        \"token\": uuid.uuid4().hex,\n    }\n\n\ndef acquire_lock(cwd: str = \"\", no_lock: bool = False,\n                 wait_minutes: int = 0) -> Optional[Path]:\n    \"\"\"Create the lock file; raises SystemExit(5) when another live\n    instance holds it (or the lock file is unparseable). With\n    wait_minutes > 0 the caller queues: poll every 30s until the holder\n    releases or the budget expires (real-world lesson: collaborators\n    share one machine; refuse-and-exit forces manual retry loops).\n    Returns the lock path (caller must release).\"\"\"\n    if no_lock:\n        return None\n    lock_path = Path(cwd or os.getcwd()) / LOCK_NAME\n    payload = _payload(cwd)\n    # Atomic publication: the payload is fully written to a unique temp\n    # file, then hard-linked into place. os.link fails with EEXIST when a\n    # lock is already present, so no reader can observe a partial file\n    # (a separate O_EXCL create + write left such a window before).\n    fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=LOCK_NAME + \".\", dir=str(lock_path.parent))\n    try:\n        with os.fdopen(fd, \"w\", encoding=\"utf-8\") as f:\n            json.dump(payload, f)\n        try:\n            os.link(tmp_name, str(lock_path))\n        except FileExistsError:\n            if wait_minutes > 0:\n                _wait_for_lock(lock_path, wait_minutes)\n            else:\n                _reject_or_break(lock_path)\n            return acquire_lock(cwd, no_lock=False)  # stale lock broken; retry\n    finally:\n        try:\n            os.unlink(tmp_name)\n        except OSError:\n        # best-effort I/O：失败不阻塞主流程（已验证有意）\n            pass\n    os.chmod(str(lock_path), 0o600)\n    _OWNED[str(lock_path)] = payload[\"token\"]\n    return lock_path\n\n\ndef _wait_for_lock(lock_path: Path, wait_minutes: int) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Poll until the holder releases the lock or the budget expires.\n    A stale lock (dead holder) is broken immediately, as usual.\"\"\"\n    deadline = time.monotonic() + wait_minutes * 60\n    while time.monotonic() < deadline:\n        if not lock_path.exists():\n            return\n        holder = _read_holder(lock_path)\n        if holder and not _alive(int(holder.get(\"pid\", 0) or 0)):\n            log.warning(\"LOCK: holder pid=%s holder else \"?\",\n                 (time.time() - holder.get(\"start\", time.time())) / 60 if holder else 0,\n                 int(deadline - time.monotonic()))\n        time.sleep(30)\n    raise stdout_target\n    if stderr_target is not None:\n        targets[\"stderr_target\"] = stderr_target\n    return _stream_proc(proc, prefix, start, timeout, emit, **targets)\ndef run_task(task: Task, _task_invocation(task, session_flags, session_name)\n    if isinstance(invocation, TaskResult):\n        annotate_result(invocation, trace_task_id, stage_id, attempt)\n        return invocation\n    cmd, workdir, session_id, effective_name = invocation\n    start, proc, completed = time.monotonic(), None, False\n    prefix, env, key, usage_before = _prepare_task_run(task, cmd, task_index, total, parallel, workdir, effective_name, session_id, trace_task_id, attempt)\n    try:\n        _rate_gate(task, effective_name)\n        proc = _spawn_agent(cmd, workdir, env)\n        _register_proc(proc)\n        write_marker(key, workdir, agent_pid=proc.pid)\n        streamed = _stream_output_enabled()\n        stdout_lines, stderr_lines, overflow = _stream_task(\n            proc, prefix, start, task.timeout, streamed,\n            stdout_target, stderr_target)\n        completed = True\n        if overflow[0]:\n            result = _overflow_result(task, proc, stdout_lines, stderr_lines, start)\n            return _finish_result(result, task, session_id, effective_name, workdir, usage_before, trace_task_id, attempt)\n        result = _result_from_proc(task, proc, stdout_lines, stderr_lines, time.monotonic() - start)\n        result.streamed_output = streamed\n        if session_flags is not None: _capture_codex_thread(\n            stdout_lines, effective_name, session_id, workdir)\n        return _finish_result(result, task, session_id, effective_name, workdir, usage_before, trace_task_id, attempt)\n    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:\n        result = _timeout_result(task, proc, start)\n        return _finish_result(result, task, session_id, effective_name, workdir, usage_before, trace_task_id, attempt)\n    except FileNotFoundError:\n        result = _agent_not_found(task)\n        return _finish_result(result, task, session_id, effective_name, workdir, usage_before, trace_task_id, attempt)\n    except Exception as e:\n        elapsed = time.monotonic() - start\n        log.error(\"ERROR  [%.1fs]  [%s]\", elapsed, e)\n        result = TaskResult(task=task, success=False, stderr=str(e), elapsed=elapsed, reason=str(e))\n        return _finish_result(result, task, session_id, effective_name, workdir, usage_before, trace_task_id, attempt)\n    finally:\n        if proc is not None and not completed:\n            _kill_group(proc)\n        if proc is not None:\n            _unregister_proc(proc)\n        clear_marker(key, workdir)\ndef _prepare_task_run(task: Task, cmd: list, task_index: int, total: int,\n _rate_gate(task: Task, session_name: str = \"\") -> None:\n    \"\"\"F line: wait for a provider token before spawning the agent. \"session_name\", \"\") or task.memory.get(\n        \"stage\", \"\") or \"batch\"\n    kind = getattr(flags, \"kind\", \"\")\n    session_id = getattr(flags, \"session_id\", \"\") or session_id_from_flags(flags)\n    prompt = task.prompt\n    if memory_enabled():\n        prompt = enrich_prompt(prompt, workdir, str(task.memory.get(\"memory_mode\", \"\")))\n        if flags is None:\n            session_id = new_session_id(name, task.prompt, workdir)\n            flags = _session_flags(\"start\", session_id, name)\n            kind = \"start\"\n    if (kind in (\"continue\", \"fork\")\n            and config.agent_session_argv_layout(config.AGENT_BIN) == \"led\"):\n        provider_session, _ = resolve_provider_session(\n            workdir, name, session_id, kind, config.AGENT_BIN)\n        flags = config.agent_session_flags(\n            kind, session_id, name, config.AGENT_BIN, provider_session=provider_session)\n    return replace(task, prompt=prompt).to_cmd(flags), workdir, session_id, name\n\ndef _capture_codex_thread(stdout_lines: list, name: str, sid: str, workdir: str) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Capture Codex's first JSONL thread event for an explicit session.\"\"\"\n    capture_codex_thread(stdout_lines, name, sid, workdir, config.AGENT_BIN)\n\ndef _output_path_is_symlink(task: Task) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"T0.1: probe the UNRESOLVED output path — output_path() resolves\n    symlinks away, which would hide a link planted at the output location\n    and redirect the write to its target (round-4 finding H1).\"\"\"\n    probe = Path(task.output)\n    if not probe.is_absolute():\n        probe = Path(task.workdir()) / probe\n    return probe.is_symlink()\n\ndef save_result(task: Task, result: TaskResult) -> None:\n    \"\"\"Write a successful task result to its output file, or print to stdout.\n    Failed or rejected results are never written to disk: quota or rate-limit\n    replies must not become committed artifacts, so the error is logged only.\n    \"\"\"\n    out_path = task.output_path()\n    if out_path is None:\n        if not result.streamed_output:\n            sys.stdout.write(result.stdout)\n            if result.stderr:\n                sys.stderr.write(result.stderr)\n        return\n\n    if not result.success:\n        log.error(\"NOT SAVED %s: task failed (exit=%d, %.1fs)\", out_path, result.returncode, result.elapsed)\n        return\n    # T12e: oversized outputs are rejected, not written (runaway agents\n    # must not fill the disk).\n    if len(result.stdout.encode(\"utf-8\")) > config.OUTPUT_MAX_BYTES:\n        log.error(\"NOT SAVED %s: output exceeds %d bytes (T12e cap)\", out_path, config.OUTPUT_MAX_BYTES)\n        return\n\n    out_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)\n    # T0.1 (full-SDLC pipeline): refuse symlink targets (a symlinked output\n    # path could redirect the write elsewhere) and use a unique mkstemp\n    # name, mirroring _save_validated's F14 hardening. Note: probe the\n    # UNRESOLVED path — output_path() resolves symlinks away.\n    if _output_path_is_symlink(task):\n        log.error(\"NOT SAVED %s: output path is a symlink (refusing to follow)\", out_path)\n        return\n    fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=out_path.name + \".\", suffix=\".tmp\", dir=str(out_path.parent))\n    os.close(fd)\n    tmp = Path(tmp_name)\n    tmp.write_text(result.stdout, encoding=\"utf-8\")\n    tmp.rename(out_path)\n    log.info(\"WROTE %s  (%d bytes)\", out_path, len(result.stdout))\n\n_RETRYABLE_REASON = re.compile(r\"rate|429|quota|network|connect|unreachable|timeout\", re.IGNORECASE)\n# P4（使用反馈）：provider 侧模型不可用/过载——快速失败后需要更长冷却\n_PROVIDER_BROKEN = re.compile(r\"model is unavailable|model_unavailable|upstream request failed|server_error\", re.IGNORECASE)\n\ndef _retry_wait(result: TaskResult, attempt: int, retry_delay: float, backoff: float) -> float:\n    \"\"\"Exponential backoff for a retry attempt; provider/network failures wait\n    at least 30s so a rate-limit window can clear. F line: equal jitter\n    breaks the thundering herd — parallel workers that failed together must\n    not re-sync into the next retry window together (rate-limit failures\n    spread within 30..60s, keeping the >=30s floor; other failures get\n    +/-50% around the base).\"\"\"\n    wait = retry_delay * (backoff ** (attempt - 1))\n    reason = result.reason or \"\"\n    if _PROVIDER_BROKEN.search(reason):\n        # provider 模型不可用：固定 60s+ 冷却（等上游恢复），连续失败由\n        # circuit/stall 治理接管；jitter 防并发惊群。\n        wait = max(wait, 60.0) + random.uniform(0, 30.0)\n        if attempt >= 3:\n            log.warning(\"Provider model unavailable (attempt %d); consider \"\n                        \"--round-delay after retries exhaust\", attempt)\n    elif _RETRYABLE_REASON.search(reason):\n        wait = max(wait, 30.0)\n        wait += random.uniform(0, min(wait, 30.0))\n    else:\n        wait *= random.uniform(0.5, 1.5)\n    return wait\n\n","exit_code":0,"status":"completed"}}

天然隔离、运行数据各自独立）；默认提示人工合并回主分支，`--auto-merge` 时由本进程充当 Merge Controller：根仓库锁内 fetch → rebase 最新主分支 → 验证门禁（`--gate`，默认探测 Makefile ci target）→ 合并（`--no-ff` 保留 checkpoint 或 `--squash`）→ 清理；`--wait-minutes` 排队（合并队列 = 根锁，忙时 exit 5）；账本 data_dir/sessions.jsonl 状态机（CREATED→RUNNING→REBASING→VALIDATING→MERGING→MERGED / ABORTED/CONFLICT/TEST_FAILED/NO_GATE/QUEUE_REFUSED/DIRTY/READY），`isolate sessions` 查询；`--copy-memory` 延续主目录会话；fail closed（非 git/分支已存在/目录非空/目标在仓库内/无任务参数 → exit 2；合并被阻 → exit 6 保留现场） | | `pbatch/config.py` `data_dir` | **运行时数据目录**（`--data-dir` / env campaign | | `tests/` | 1200+ 个回归测试（`make ci`，另含 42 个 eval 规则回归用例） | | `docs/SPEC_SYSTEM.md` | 规范体系总览：资产分层/注册表/决策链/门禁/角色/沉淀闭环/克制原则 | | `docs/` | 机制文档（`RUNNING_247.md`、`AUTOMATION_WORKFLOW_SUMMARY.md` 等） | | `pi-batch.yaml` | 声明式配置：agent 二进制、会话标志、31 个验证器（含 `pyquality`、`refusalcheck`、`baseline`、`authority`、`evidence`、`nongoal`、`changebudget`） |  **可移植性**：把 `pi-batch.py`（薄壳）+ `pbatch/` 目录 + `pi-batch.yaml` 复制到其他项目即可用；配置查找顺序为入口脚本旁 → 包目录 → 工作目录。 通过 `pip install .` 安装时，wheel 也会分发 `{tool_root}` 所需的规则、脚本、 示例、角色模板与评估资产；`pi-batch health --json` 对缺失资产 fail closed。  ## 2. 能力机制  ### 2.1 任务与输入方式  | 起点 | 用法 | |---|---| | 一句话 | pipeline 阶段 `from_prompt: \\\"...\\\"` + `output`（无需任何输入文件） | | 目录文档 | 阶段 `from_dir: docs/requirements` | | 阶段串联 | `from_outputs: <阶段名>` 或阶段名列表（`aggregate: true` 把多个上游全部产出合并为一份证据） | | 单批 | `-p \\\"prompt\\\"` / stdin / YAML `tasks:` 列表 |  结构化 task/pipeline 文件启动前执行 fail-closed schema 检查：阶段名和上游引用、 输入源、任务/命令类型、正数 worker/timeout/meta 上限、task validator 以及 prompt template 路径必须有效；坏 YAML/JSON 不会降级成普通 prompt 交给 agent。 CLI 的负数/零值和 NaN/Inf 延迟同样在创建日志、锁或子进程之前以退出码 2 拒绝。  阶段证据采用“产物完整保留、prompt 有界注入”：`pi-batch.yaml` `evidence.max_bytes`（默认 64KiB）是一次 aggregate/meta prompt 的来源内容总预算， `evidence.max_sources`（默认 64）独立限制路径遍历、fence 和 `{input_path}` 清单。 选中的多个来源公平分配预算；截断标记保留完整产物路径，省略标记保留计数， LLM 可在确有需要时按需读取， meta 每轮从产物清单重建上下文而不是递归复制旧 prompt。 `{prompt}` 占位符可在 pipeline 的 `from_prompt`、任务模板和 `meta_prompt` 中使用：`-p \\\"任务\\\" --classify` 路由到实现流水线时，原始任务提示会被注入 （此前 `<original task>` 是字面量、从不替换——aero-id 维护 R5 复盘修复）； 未带原始提示运行时替换为空串，模板不会泄露裸占位符。 最终 prompt 还受 `prompt.max_bytes`（默认 120KiB）硬门约束，以低于 Linux 常见 128KiB 单 argv 上限；超限在启动 agent 前明确失败，避免不可诊断的 `E2BIG`。  ### 2.2 结果校验（错误处理）  agent 回复**不是正确输出时一律不落盘**：  - 退出码非 0、空输出 → 拒绝 - 失败签名（即使退出码 0）→ 拒绝：   - 额度/速率/计费/认证：`insufficient_quota`、`rate_limit_error`、     `quota_exceeded`、`429 Too Many Requests`、`authentication_error`…   - 网络/断网：`network is unreachable`、`no route to host`、DNS 失败、     `connection refused/reset`、`curl: (N)`、`ECONNREFUSED`…   - CLI 横幅：行首 `ERROR:` / `fatal:` - 防误判：不匹配宽泛词（`error`/`timeout`/`401`），评审正文不会被误杀 - `--timeout`（默认 900s，配置 `default_timeout` 可覆盖）超时 → 进程组   SIGKILL，拒绝并零孤儿进程。硬超时按绝对截止时间执行（管道线程不延长   窗口）；pi 侧 HTTP 空闲超时 `httpIdleTimeoutMs` 默认 300s（项目级   `.pi/settings.json` 已调大到 900s，两者对齐） - stdout/stderr 以固定 8KiB 字符块排空；即使 agent 输出超长无换行单行，   也不会在 `OUTPUT_MAX_BYTES` 截断判断前由 `readline()` 全量载入内存 - 拒绝 = 无产物文件；任务失败 → 可自动重试/下轮重跑 - 被拒产物保留**有界摘录**（默认 64KiB）到任务 cwd 的   `.pi-batch/rejected/<name>-<时间戳>.rejected.md` 并在日志指出路径——   交付物路径保持零残留，但人工/重试可诊断\\\"验证器到底拒绝了什么\\\"   （aero-id 维护 R5 复盘修复：completion 门禁两次拒绝均无明细可查） - 并行批次在调度前拒绝重复输出、嵌套输出，以及不同 `cwd` 之间的输出目录包含关系   （退出码 2，不启动 agent）；显式提供 `run_parallel(waves=...)` 时，仅允许同一波次   无冲突，并在波次之间设置屏障。  ### 2.3 工程质量验证  声明式验证器注册表（像 `engineering.yaml` 之于 `cli.py`）：  ```yaml # pi-batch.yaml（当前共 24 个；以下为核心示例） validators:   quick: \\\"python cli.py check\\\"   gofmt: 'test -z \\\"$(gofmt -l {output})\\\"'   build: \\\"go build ./... && go vet ./...\\\"   config: \\\"python cli.py config-validate\\\"   root: \\\"python cli.py check-root\\\"   pyquality: \\\"python {cwd}/quality.py {cwd}\\\" ```  - `--validate quick,gofmt`：命名引用，AND 语义（全部通过才落盘）；文件级   validator 最多 4 路并行执行并按声明顺序裁决，仓库级 validator 延后到阶段末 - `validate: jsonschema=schemas/result.schema.json`：结构化产物按声明 schema   机械校验；同样参与重试反馈、零残留拒绝和 `--reuse` 复验 - **每阶段可选**：任务 `validate` > 阶段 `validate_cmd` > CLI > 无；   空字符串显式禁用（分析类任务跳过，代码生成类保留） - 机制：输出写临时文件（`{output}` 占位符）→ 验证命令 → 通过则原子   rename，失败则删除零残留；`{tool_root}` 占位符展开为工具仓库根   （validator/stage 命令可引用随仓库分发的脚本，替代硬编码绝对路径，   sverp 实战反馈） - 外部验证器 stdout/stderr 分别受 `validation.output_max_bytes`（默认 256KiB）   约束；超限按验证失败关闭，避免 noisy gate 在超时前耗尽 runner 内存 - stage `commands` 同样使用进程组硬截止与有界诊断；全局默认由   `commands.timeout/output_max_bytes` 控制，阶段可用   `command_timeout/command_output_max_bytes` 覆盖  ### 2.4 断点续跑与 7×24  | 参数 | 作用 | |---|---| | `--reuse` | 当前 validator 复验已有输出；通过才复用，stage `commands` 仍重跑；**gate 阶段例外**——含 `VERDICT: FAIL/REJECT`（或无裁决）的产物永不复用（裁决绑定仓库状态，fingerprint 看不见代码变化；修复后被拒 gate 会被删除并重审，PASS 裁决复用会显式告警），aero-id 维护 R5e 复盘修复 | | `--retries N` | 任务失败自动重试，指数退避；速率/网络类至少等 30s | | `--max-rounds N`（0=无限） | 轮循环直到全部通过，`--round-delay` 轮间休息 | | `--min-interval` | 成功任务间节流 | | `--log-file` | 时间戳日志落盘（配合 `tail -f`/systemd 监控） | | `--stream-output auto|full|none` | 模型正文实时展示策略；默认仅 TTY 展示 |  配套：`run-review.py --all --resume` 从磁盘输出续跑并接力链上下文；已有阶段会先 经过本次命令指定的 validator，失效产物自动重新生成。  运行日志与 message 分层管理：`--log-file` 只记录生命周期、重试、验证和 Gate 等运营元数据；完整模型正文保留在任务产物和 agent 原生会话中。 `auto` 在 nohup/CI/systemd 等非 TTY 场景不实时复制正文，`full`/`none` 可显式 覆盖。无 `output` 的单问答仍会在任务结束时把最终答案输出一次。Campaign 隔离流水线由子进程的轮转 handler 单独写日志，避免同一路径双写和轮转竞争。  ### 2.5 会话模式  ```bash --session-mode new        # 默认：每次调用新会话 --session-mode shared     # 整个批次/流水线一个会话（后续步骤延续上下文） --session-mode per-stage  # 流水线每阶段一个会话 ```  - 标志来自 `pi-batch.yaml` `agent.session_flags`（pi 风格默认，可适配其他 CLI） - 共享会话要求串行（并行会乱序，runner 拒绝该组合） - 会话 id 由 `--session-name` 派生（可重现）→ 断点续跑延续同一会话  ### 2.5.1 渐进式 Message Memory  Pi 原始 JSONL message 保持不变；runner 为新任务分配可追踪的 session id，并把 任务、验证器、Gate、C 域）；L1=demo/L2=standard/L3=production（product_manifest specs 派生）|  路由优先级：classifier 先行——同时含产品信号与前端/后端信号的任务（如“做一个 SaaS 计费前端页面”）取 backend/frontend_ui 注册表而非 product；产品规范仍经 `assess` 的 `product_manifest`（按 level 驱动、与域无关）到达。  每条规则：`id / description / files / min_tier / page_types / risk / required_when_risk / profiles`。`pi-batch rules --check` 校验 schema； 规则不得引用注册表文件自身——自引用 `files`/`files_template` 会被 `rules --check` 拒绝（fail closed）。  ## 3. 决策链（一次任务如何被处理）  ``` 需求文本  ├─ classify      判域：frontend_ui / backend / analysis / ...  ├─ rules         算法匹配规则 manifest（scale×page_type×risk）+ LLM 双向校验  │ suggestion（只注入不拦截） - **探索豁免**：spike/原型任务自动降级非 invariant 规律（创新不被锁死） - **项目宪法**：`docs/evolution/constitution.yaml`（明确不做/变更预算/   豁免留痕 90 天复查）；campaign 方向撞明确不做 fail closed - **验证优先**：pipeline init|check|report  # 宪法生成/门禁/规律报告 pi-batch evolution override --rule X --reason \\\"...\\\"  # 豁免留痕 pi-batch learn ... --registry evolution  # 实战事故→规律（强制 samples） ```  ## 7. 克制原则（整个体系的纪律）  - 小 demo（L0/scale S）只加载视觉核心 2 条规则；生产级才全套 - 处方档 = min(关键词档, 规模档)——\\\"企业登录页\\\"不因\\\"企业\\\"二字全量上规则 - 无商业信号不设计 Billing；无开源意图不生成开源文档；无第二使用方不抽象 - 推演出的隐含需求是\\\"待确认问题\\\"，未经确认禁止实现 - 每次规则选择都有证据与 provenance，可审计 # ai-batch-runner  An interactive terminal workbench and governed batch/pipeline runtime for **any CLI-based coding agent** — local-first and not tied to one vendor. Point it at `pi`, [Claude Code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code), Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, or configure `agent.argument_flags` for another argv contract. The built-in adapter accepts:  ---  ## 快速开始（产品 CLI）  ```bash pipx install ai-batch-runner       # 推荐：隔离安装正式版本 # 或：uv tool install ai-batch-runner / pip install ai-batch-runner pi-batch                  # 默认产品入口：交互式 TUI（真实终端） pi-batch doctor           # 环境诊断：安装/目录/配置/agent/密钥/锁 pi-batch init             # 创建用户级工作目录骨架 pi-batch version          # 版本 + 环境 pi-batch -p \\\"写一个订单接口，含支付审批，生产，go\\\" --classify   # 一句话 → 全流程 pi-batch completion bash >> ~/.bashrc    # shell 补全（zsh 同理） ```  从源码开发安装使用 `pip install -e \\\".[dev]\\\"`。维护者发布流程见 [`docs/RELEASING.md`](docs/RELEASING.md)。  构建 wheel 安装时会同时携带规则注册表、验证脚本、默认流水线、角色模板和 评估集；`pi-batch health --json` 会检查分发资产是否完整。  ### 用户级工作目录（XDG 兼容）  | 目录 | 用途 | |---|---| | `~/.config/pbatch/settings.yaml` | 用户配置（跨项目偏好） | | `~/.cache/pbatch/` | 可丢弃缓存 | | `~/.local/share/pbatch/keys/` | 设备身份密钥（跨项目复用） | | `~/.local/share/pbatch/logs/` | 全局运行日志 |  `PBATCH_HOME=~/.pbatch` 可统一收拢三目录。**配置分层**： CLI 参数 > 项目 `pi-batch.yaml` > 用户 settings.yaml > 内置默认。 项目相关状态（会话/记忆/被拒产物）保留在项目内 `.pi-batch/`——随仓库共享。  配置变更建议先做只读核验：  ```bash pi-batch config explain       # 来源、覆盖关系、脱敏后的最终配置与运行时值 pi-batch config check         # 版本/结构校验，适合 CI pi-batch config check --file pi-batch.yaml --json ```  `pi-batch.yaml` 使用 `config_version: 1`。缺省版本按 legacy v0 兼容；高于当前支持版本 会 fail closed。`config explain` 不创建目录、不启动 agent；报告中的敏感键（token、password、 private key 等）只显示 `<redacted>`。  ### 功能全景  - **50+ 子命令**：需求评估（assess/classify/profile/probe）→ 流程编排   （campaign/org/advance/race/pareto）→ 规则知识（rules/learn/adr/context/   memory/capsule/replay）→ 治理（truth/causal/temporal/pinned/metrics/   budget/recovery/events/world）→ 设备织网（devices/serve/runner）→ **实战规律   （evolution：形态分类/规律分级路由/项目宪法/管线形状推荐）** - **1086+ 回归测试 + 42 eval 用例**；`pi-batch check` 8 门禁聚合自检 - 零 LLM 确定性核心：所有检测/路由/校验纯 stdlib + ast，可测试、fail closed - 详见 `docs/`（AADM 理论四卷、AGENT_ORGANIZATION、CAMPAIGN_LESSONS）与 `AGENTS.md`  ``` <bin> -p PROMPT [--model M] [--provider P] [--thinking T] [--tools T] [--exclude-tools T] ```  and it will run one prompt, a batch of prompts (serial or parallel), or a multi-stage pipeline against it, with per-task output capture, engineering validation gates, session reuse, exponential-backoff retries, and optional auto git-commit after each stage.  > **Provenance**: this tree is a sync of `snaplink/ai-dev` (the living monorepo copy), carried > over as-is including its regression test suite. The engine now lives in the `pbatch/` > package with `pi-batch.py` as a thin entry shim (the reference's current layout; the > earlier 4-file split and the 1389-line monolith were both superseded). `tests/` > is the authoritative behavior spec. > > **Local adaptations** (everything else stays byte-identical): `pi-batch.yaml` > `validators.pyquality` points at `{cwd}/quality.py` (reference used an `ai-dev/` > prefix from snaplink's repo layout); **all `ai-dev/` path prefixes were stripped > from commands, prompts, docs and code comments** — this repo's root IS the > `ai-dev` content, so `python ai-dev/pi-batch.py` → `python pi-batch.py`, > `ai-dev/prompts` → `prompts`; upstream's `make ai-dev-test` → this repo's > `make ci`. Only historical upstream-name mentions (`snaplink/ai-dev`) remain. > > **Local fixes** (self-iteration round 1, driven by the meta-review pipeline in > `docs/self-iteration.yaml` — see `docs/reviews/`): > - `Task.output_path()` resolves relative outputs against `task.cwd` (was: process cwd); >   `_filter_reused` follows suit (`pbatch/models.py`, `pbatch/cli.py`) > - `_git_commit_stage` and single-batch git commit check exit codes and log real failures >   (`pbatch/pipeline.py`, `pbatch/cli.py`) > - `load_tasks` fails loud when PyYAML is missing for a `.yaml`/`tasks:` file >   (`pbatch/pipeline.py`) > - `save_result` writes atomically (tmp+rename) on the no-validator path too >   (`pbatch/runner.py`) > - `git-auto-commit.sh`: protected-branch guard + sensitive-file exclusions > - tests: `tests/test_local_fixes.py` (10 cases); config-resolution tests run with a >   clean env (`PBATCH_SCRIPT_DIR` can no longer hijack them) > > **Local fixes** (self-iteration round 2): > - F1: `from_dir` constructors emit absolute output paths — the round-1 cwd-aware >   `output_path()` otherwise double-prefixed them (`docs/inputs/docs/inputs/...`) > - P0-1: stage outputs, meta role outputs and single-batch git-commit inputs now >   propagate **resolved** paths (`output_path()`), so git add / `_combine_outputs` / >   archiving / decision logs can no longer operate on decoy process-cwd files > - F2: `run_task` and `ai/run-review.py::_run_agent` kill the child process group on >   ANY abnormal exit (Ctrl-C/SIGTERM included) — no more orphaned agents > - F3/F14: validator `{output}`/`{cwd}` substitutions are shell-quoted; temp files use >   unique mkstemp names; validators run in their own process group with a killable >   timeout (`_run_validator`) > - F5: task log lines show the prompt truncated to 80 chars (prompt content no longer >   shipped verbatim by `--log-file`) > - F9: stdin is consumed once before the round loop — `--max-rounds` no longer dies >   with \\\"Provide a prompt\\\" on round 2+ for stdin batches > - F12: gate verdict regex is line-anchored (`^\\\\s*VERDICT\\\\s*:`) — prose mentions no >   longer unlock a gate > - `.coverage` tolerated by root-policy and gitignored; Makefile/docs test counts >   refreshed > - tests: 9 more cases in `tests/test_local_fixes.py` (19 total) > > **Local fixes** (full-SDLC pipeline round, T1/T2 per `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_T0_CLOSEOUT.md`): > - T1 `pbatch/reuse.py::reuse_decision()`: reuse requires exists ∧ non-empty ∧ not-symlink >   ∧ all effective validators still pass; stale artifacts are deleted for regeneration; >   all six reuse sites wired; `--reuse-legacy` escape hatch > - T2: `TaskResult` additive validation fields; validator stderr (capped 4000/40) + exit >   flow into the retry prompt; summary shows the validator exit signature; `run_serial`/ >   `run_parallel` share `_run_with_gate` > - `revalidate_existing` fails closed on symlink artifacts (QA-1 complete) > - tests: 11 more cases (30 total in `tests/test_local_fixes.py`) > > **Local fixes** (7x24 governance, T3-T5 per `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_7x24_GOVERNANCE.md`): > - T3 log rotation (`RotatingFileHandler`, `--log-max-bytes`/`--log-backups`) > - T4 single-instance lock (`pbatch/lock.py`, O_EXCL, stale detection, exit 5) > - T5 triage (`pbatch/triage.py`): circuit isolation (`--circuit-max`), >   stall detection (`--stall-rounds`, exit 4), residue markers >   (`.pi-batch/state/`), environment-class halt (shared validator stderr) > - tests: 12 more cases (42 total in `tests/test_local_fixes.py`) > > **Local fixes** (cost governance, T6-T8 per `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_7x24_GOVERNANCE.md`): > - T6 spike verified pi session files (`~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<cwd>--/`, >   `message.usage` JSON pointers) — report in `docs/spike-pi-session.md` > - T7 `pbatch/metering.py`: `--events-file` JSONL events (task_finish/ >   task_fail/budget_cap) with per-call session usage diff; each event carries >   `schema_version`, `event_id`, `run_id`, `task_id`, `stage_id`, `attempt` >   and `phase`; `--run-id` can supply an external correlation id; `--webhook` >   non-blocking delivery; usage:null degradation > - T8 budgets: `--budget-max` (per run) + `--daily-budget` (UTC state >   file); cap wins over `--max-rounds 0`, exit 3 > - tests: 3 more cases (45 total in `tests/test_local_fixes.py`) > > **Local fixes** (hardening, T11/T13 per `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_7x24_GOVERNANCE.md`): > - T11 hetero-routing: pipeline task defs pass provider/thinking/tools/ >   exclude_tools to the agent argv; stage-level model/provider for meta >   stages; `--provider` CLI override (CLI > task > stage > default) > - T13: SIGINT orphan test hardened with a pid/go handshake (no start race) > - tests: 3 more cases (48 total in `tests/test_local_fixes.py`) > > **Local fixes** (governance close-out, T9/T10/T12 per plan): > - T9 fingerprint reuse 2.0: `--reuse-fingerprint` + sidecar >   (`<output>.meta.json`, sha256 of inputs/gate/routing); input change >   regenerates; wired through all six reuse sites + single-batch > - T10 session rotation: `--session-max-bytes` watermark forks the shared >   session via pi's `--fork`; compaction warnings (`pbatch/session.py`) > - T12 governance: validator JSON status (pass/warn/fail), bare >   `VERDICT: PASS` fails closed, `<evidence>` fences in combined inputs, >   output byte cap (2MB), `secretscan` validator registry entry > - tests: 18 more cases (66 total in `tests/test_local_fixes.py`); >   upstream gate/evidence fixtures updated for the new fail-closed and >   fence semantics > - T12c approval stages (decision D5): `approval: true` pauses the >   pipeline at a human gate — PBATCH_APPROVE=1 env / `--approve-file` / >   interactive TTY, fail-closed otherwise (5 tests; 71 local total) >    > These pbatch/ + ai/ edits will need re-applying after the next upstream sync (they are > the only divergence from snaplink/ai-dev).  > **Repository campaigns and relevance-bounded meta roles**: > - `pi-batch.py campaign` discovers project modules, runs parallel structured >   analyses, scores/deduplicates evidence-backed directions, and executes the >   selected directions through a full SDLC pipeline. > - `docs/auto/state.jsonl` is the append-only source of truth; `SUMMARY.md` is >   regenerated from it. Input fingerprints make `--reuse`/`--skip-passed` >   freshness-aware instead of trusting a non-empty Markdown file. > - analysis parallelism stays inside the lock-owning process. Parallel >   implementation uses one Git worktree, branch, output tree, decision log, >   and run log per direction. > - meta stages score role templates with `pbatch/role_keywords.yaml`, inject >   matched-keyword evidence, deduplicate the model plan, and enforce >   `max_roles_per_iteration` at runtime.  ## Switching agents  The agent binary is a config value, not a hardcoded dependency — edit `agent.bin` in `pi-batch.yaml`, or pass `--agent-bin` on the command line:  ```yaml # pi-batch.yaml agent:   bin: pi              # or: claude, codex, gemini, opencode, ...   default_model: \\\"\\\"   default_timeout: 300   default_workers: 4   argument_flags:          # per-agent overrides are also supported     prompt: \\\"-p\\\"           # use \\\"\\\" for a positional prompt     model: \\\"--model\\\" ```  Before a non-dry run starts, the CLI checks that the selected executable is available. Project validators use `project.frontend_root`, `backend_root`, and `report_root`; relative values resolve against the task working directory. Regular wheel installs also carry the default pipelines, role prompts, rule registries, eval suites and checker scripts. Project-local assets take precedence; installed assets are the fallback, so `pi-batch rules`, `eval`, `check`, `campaign`, and classifier routing work outside this checkout. `pi-batch health` is also runnable from a wheel, but its default self-check honestly reports unhealthy when the wheel has no source tests (tests are not shipped); use `pi-batch health --dir /path/to/project` to assess a target project.  Configuration sections are type-checked at startup. Malformed section/value types are reported and replaced with bounded built-in defaults, so a typo does not crash the long-running coordinator during module import.  ```bash python pi-batch.py tasks.yaml --agent-bin claude --mode parallel --workers 4 python pi-batch.py tasks.yaml --agent-bin codex  --mode serial ```  ## Quick start  ```bash # Install as a global CLI command (like pi/codex), then use it anywhere: pipx install ai-batch-runner # or: uv tool install / pip install pi-batch                    # interactive TUI on a real terminal pi-batch tui                # explicit TUI entry pi-batch -p \\\"analyze this project\\\" -o output.md python -m pbatch ...        # same entry, no install needed python pi-batch.py ...      # zero-install fallback from the repo root  # Task type classifier: decide BEFORE execution whether a task is frontend UI pi-batch classify \\\"用 Flutter 实现 ERP 排程列表页\\\" pi-batch classify tasks.yaml --json        # machine-readable  # Requirement assessment: prescription + productization + workflow level pi-batch assess \\\"企业订单管理：新建订单表单，含支付审批流程\\\" pi-batch assess --file requirements.md     # from a document pi-batch assess \\\"...\\\" --prompt             # compiled instruction block for the agent pi-batch assess \\\"...\\\" --json  # Rule matching (scale × page_type × risk) + two-sided LLM check pi-batch rules \\\"生成一个登录页 demo\\\" pi-batch rules --check                     # registry schema integrity (three domains) pi-batch rules \\\"...\\\" --summary | --llm-prompt p.txt | --llm-json '{...}'  # Context routing + evolution + self-check pi-batch context \\\"任务\\\" --paths src/order/**   # project documents for a task pi-batch learn \\\"订单并发创建重复记录\\\"            # RCA -> rule draft (--from-memory TERM) pi-batch eval                                  # rule-system regression suite (42 cases) pi-batch check                                 # one-command self-check pi-batch tasks.yaml --validate 'jsonschema=schemas/result.schema.json'  # Frontend task: --classify routes it to the frontend implementation # pipeline (real code in the project; plan -> implement with # uiquality/uicheck/completion gates -> adversarial review -> verdict) # (classifier.frontend_pipeline), which applies ui-specs + UI validators # (uispacing/uicolor/uistyle/uifont) + meta UI review + verdict gate pi-batch -p \\\"生成一个登录页面 tsx\\\" --classify --dry-run  # Batch from a YAML task file pi-batch tasks.yaml --mode parallel --workers 4  # Multi-stage pipeline (chained roles, e.g. architect -> tech-lead -> implementer -> qa -> security) pi-batch --pipeline pipelines/pipeline-code-impl.yaml  # 24x7 loop: rerun failed tasks until everything passes pi-batch tasks.yaml --max-rounds 0 --round-delay 60  # Repository campaign: inspect the plan, then analyze and implement Top N directions pi-batch campaign --dry-run pi-batch campaign --max-directions 2 --reuse --retry-failed ```  ### Interactive terminal UI  Running `pi-batch` without arguments opens the Textual workbench when both stdin and stdout are interactive terminals. Use **Ctrl+P** for the command palette, **Ctrl+N** for a new task, **Ctrl+L** to clear the transcript, **Ctrl+C** to cancel the active run, and **Ctrl+Q** to quit.  Slash commands are available from the prompt: `/help`, `/status`, `/new`, `/clear`, `/model`, `/provider`, `/agent`, `/memory`, `/doctor`, and `/quit`. `/help` shows the current syntax and state-dependent behavior. The full startup, trust-boundary, and release contract is documented in [`docs/TUI_PRODUCT.md`](docs/TUI_PRODUCT.md).  The automatic TUI never activates when either stdin or stdout is redirected, so existing scripts and CI remain headless-compatible. Piped prompts and all explicit batch/subcommands keep their original behavior:  ```bash printf 'analyze this repository\\\\n' | pi-batch pi-batch -p \\\"analyze this repository\\\" --stream-output none pi-batch tui --help ```  Example `tasks.yaml`:  ```yaml tasks:   - prompt: \\\"Analyze the project expansion directions\\\"     output: docs/expansion.md     model: claude-sonnet     cwd: /path/to/project    - prompt: \\\"Review security edge cases\\\"     output: docs/security-review.md     model: claude-sonnet:high     cwd: /path/to/project ```  ## Feature map  - **Task type classifier**: `--classify` + `pi-batch.py classify` subcommand run a   deterministic bilingual keyword gate BEFORE execution (zero LLM cost); a   frontend-dominated batch routes to the configured UI generation pipeline   (`classifier.frontend_pipeline`, default   `examples/frontend-implementation-pipeline.yaml`).   Keywords are additive-extensible via `pbatch/task_keywords.yaml`; platform   mention (tsx/dart/flutter/vue/react-native) boosts the frontend decision;   explicit `--pipeline` always wins; missing pipeline file fails loudly. - **Rule matcher** (`pi-batch rules`): the spec system is large, so a small demo   must not load all of it. `pbatch/rule_matcher.py` + `ui-specs/rules.yaml`   algorithmically select the applicable rules along three axes — scale   (demo < standard < production, default standard), page type (form/table/   detail/workbench/immersive/auth) and risk (high-risk pay/approve/delete   flows force error-recovery + defect-patterns). Output is a bounded manifest   (paths + why + skipped reasons); prompts inject ONLY the manifest and agents   load files on demand (progressive disclosure). - **Backend architecture governance** (`backend-specs/` + `backendquality`): the   same layered machinery now covers backend work — the classifier already   separates backend tasks, and the rule matcher/assessor pick the backend   registry automatically (`backend-specs/rules.yaml`, signals: use   cases/entities/integrations/distribution). Specs: architecture (module   organization by business capability, Transport → Application → Domain ←   Infrastructure dependency direction, data ownership, composition over   inheritance), design-patterns (pattern selection DECISION TABLE keyed on   problems, over-engineering red lines — no interface per class, no factory   per object, no BaseService/Manager soup, rule of three), domain-modeling   (state machines centralized, domain objects protect invariants, UoW at the   use-case boundary), evolution (refactor triggers, ADR, tech debt, migration   windows). [evidence truncated: showing 23565 of 44955 bytes; full artifact: /home/u1/ai-batch-runner/README.md] </evidence>  <evidence source=\\\"CHECKS_REGISTRY\\\"> # CHECKS_REGISTRY — ai-batch-runner 工程门禁注册表  本仓库的工程质量门禁体系仿照 `snaplink` 的质量管理（`cli.py` + `checks/` + `engineering.yaml` + `make ci` + git hooks + CI），针对 Python 项目做了适配。 核心原则与 snaplink 一致：  1. **零依赖可移植**：门禁只用标准库（ast/unittest），复制 `cli.py` +    `checks/` + `engineering.yaml` 到任意 Python 项目即可复用，只改 YAML 配置。 2. **门禁约束自研代码**：与上游 `snaplink/ai-dev` 同步的引擎文件    （`pi-batch.py`、`ai/run-review.py`）通过 `engineering.yaml` 的    `ignore_patterns` 豁免——质量规则只约束我们自主编写的代码。 3. **门禁自身有单测**（`checks/test_*.py`，`make self-test`）：检查器坏了    必须能被发现。  ## 门禁清单  | 门禁 | 命令 | 阈值 | 说明 | |---|---|---|---| | G1 filesize | `make check-filesize` | 500 行/文件 | 源文件行数预算；豁免清单（`exemptions`）只减不增 | | G2 complexity | `make check-complexity` | 圈复杂度 15 / 认知复杂度 20（每函数） | ast 实现，替代 gocyclo/gocognit | | G3 root policy | `make check-root` | 根目录 ≤16 文件 | 根目录只允许配置/入口/文档；禁止 `*_test.py` 散落根目录 | | G4 style | `make check-style` | 行宽 100（警告） | 行尾空白、tab 缩进、缺末尾换行、非 utf-8 为硬失败 | | G5 quality | `make quality` | 函数 50 行 / 圈复杂度 15 / 文件 1000 行 / 重复函数体 | 参考版自带扫描器 `quality.py`（纯 stdlib），经 `pi-batch.yaml` 注册为 `validators.pyquality` | | H0 self-test | `make self-test` | — | 门禁自身单测（50 例，unittest 零依赖） | | T0 regression | `make test` | — | 引擎、规则系统/评估器/检查器与 Campaign 回归套件（pytest，需 dev extras） | | E0 eval | `make eval` | 42 项 | classify/rules/assess/product/workflow 行为回归 | | T1 coverage | `make coverage` | — | checks/ + cli.py 覆盖率报告（需 pytest-cov） |  ### Agent 结构化产物门禁  `jsonschema=<path>` 是任务/阶段级 validator，不默认加入本仓库 CI。它调用 `scripts/check-json-schema.py`，在产物原子落盘和 `--reuse` 复验前校验纯 JSON； 非法 JSON、未知约束关键字、外部 `$ref` 和 schema 不匹配均 fail closed。  ## 使用  ```bash make check          # G1-G4 零依赖门禁 make self-test      # H0 门禁自身单测 make quality        # G5 组织质量扫描（quality.py，上游同步） make test           # T0 回归套件（pip install -e \\\".[dev]\\\"） make ci             # G1-G5 + H0 + T0 + E0 + organization contracts python cli.py check-filesize   # 单独跑某门禁 ```  ## 配置（engineering.yaml）  各门禁阈值与豁免均在 `engineering.yaml` 中声明：  - `filesize.max_lines` / `ignore_patterns` / `exemptions` - `complexity.max_cyclomatic` / `max_cognitive` / `ignore_patterns` - `root_policy.max_files` / `allowed_files` / `banned_patterns` - `style.max_line_length` / `ignore_patterns`  `ignore_patterns` 为子串匹配（snaplink 语义）。新增业务代码必须通过全部门禁； 需要放宽阈值时先改 YAML 再提交，并在 commit message 中说明理由。  ## Git hooks  ```bash git config core.hooksPath .githooks ```  - `pre-commit`：对暂存的 `.py` 文件跑 filesize + style 门禁（豁免规则同上） - `pre-push`：跑 `cli.py harness`（= `make check` + `make self-test`）  ## 上游同步豁免  `pbatch/`（引擎包）、`pi-batch.py`（入口 shim）、`ai/run-review.py`、`quality.py` 均为与 `snaplink/ai-dev` 同步的上游文件，经 `engineering.yaml` 的 `ignore_patterns` 豁免（这些模块仍须通过 `quality.py` 的 1000 行预算； 参考版自带的行尾空白与复杂度超过本仓库更严预算的少数函数一并豁免）。 质量规则实际约束自研代码：`checks/`、`cli.py`、`Makefile` 及新增业务代码。  ## CI  `.github/workflows/ci.yml`：Python 3.11 + `pip install -e \\\".[dev]\\\"`，依次执行 G1-G5、H0、T0、E0、organization contracts、T1。推送到 `main` 或 PR 时触发。  </evidence> </project-context> --approve-for-me `pi-batch.yaml` 复制到其他项目即可用；配置查找顺序为入口脚本旁 → 包目录 → 工作目录。 通过 `pip install .` 安装时，wheel 也会分发 `{tool_root}` 所需的规则、脚本、 示例、角色模板与评估资产；`pi-batch health --json` 对缺失资产 fail closed。  ## 2. 能力机制  ### 2.1 任务与输入方式  | 起点 | 用法 | |---|---| | 一句话 | pipeline 阶段 `from_prompt: \\\"...\\\"` + `output`（无需任何输入文件） | | 目录文档 | 阶段 `from_dir: docs/requirements` | | 阶段串联 | `from_outputs: <阶段名>` 或阶段名列表（`aggregate: true` 把多个上游全部产出合并为一份证据） | | 单批 | `-p \\\"prompt\\\"` / stdin / YAML `tasks:` 列表 |  结构化 task/pipeline 文件启动前执行 fail-closed schema 检查：阶段名和上游引用、 输入源、任务/命令类型、正数 worker/timeout/meta 上限、task validator 以及 prompt template 路径必须有效；坏 YAML/JSON 不会降级成普通 prompt 交给 agent。 CLI 的负数/零值和 NaN/Inf 延迟同样在创建日志、锁或子进程之前以退出码 2 拒绝。  阶段证据采用“产物完整保留、prompt 有界注入”：`pi-batch.yaml` `evidence.max_bytes`（默认 64KiB）是一次 aggregate/meta prompt 的来源内容总预算， `evidence.max_sources`（默认 64）独立限制路径遍历、fence 和 `{input_path}` 清单。 选中的多个来源公平分配预算；截断标记保留完整产物路径，省略标记保留计数， LLM 可在确有需要时按需读取， meta 每轮从产物清单重建上下文而不是递归复制旧 prompt。 `{prompt}` 占位符可在 pipeline 的 `from_prompt`、任务模板和 `meta_prompt` 中使用：`-p \\\"任务\\\" --classify` 路由到实现流水线时，原始任务提示会被注入 （此前 `<original task>` 是字面量、从不替换——aero-id 维护 R5 复盘修复）； 未带原始提示运行时替换为空串，模板不会泄露裸占位符。 最终 prompt 还受 `prompt.max_bytes`（默认 120KiB）硬门约束，以低于 Linux 常见 128KiB 单 argv 上限；超限在启动 agent 前明确失败，避免不可诊断的 `E2BIG`。  ### 2.2 结果校验（错误处理）  agent 回复**不是正确输出时一律不落盘**：  - 退出码非 0、空输出 → 拒绝 - 失败签名（即使退出码 0）→ 拒绝：   - 额度/速率/计费/认证：`insufficient_quota`、`rate_limit_error`、     `quota_exceeded`、`429 Too Many Requests`、`authentication_error`…   - 网络/断网：`network is unreachable`、`no route to host`、DNS 失败、     `connection refused/reset`、`curl: (N)`、`ECONNREFUSED`…   - CLI 横幅：行首 `ERROR:` / `fatal:` - 防误判：不匹配宽泛词（`error`/`timeout`/`401`），评审正文不会被误杀 - `--timeout`（默认 900s，配置 `default_timeout` 可覆盖）超时 → 进程组   SIGKILL，拒绝并零孤儿进程。硬超时按绝对截止时间执行（管道线程不延长   窗口）；pi 侧 HTTP 空闲超时 `httpIdleTimeoutMs` 默认 300s（项目级   `.pi/settings.json` 已调大到 900s，两者对齐） - stdout/stderr 以固定 8KiB 字符块排空；即使 agent 输出超长无换行单行，   也不会在 `OUTPUT_MAX_BYTES` 截断判断前由 `readline()` 全量载入内存 - 拒绝 = 无产物文件；任务失败 → 可自动重试/下轮重跑 - 被拒产物保留**有界摘录**（默认 64KiB）到任务 cwd 的   `.pi-batch/rejected/<name>-<时间戳>.rejected.md` 并在日志指出路径——   交付物路径保持零残留，但人工/重试可诊断\\\"验证器到底拒绝了什么\\\"   （aero-id 维护 R5 复盘修复：completion 门禁两次拒绝均无明细可查） - 并行批次在调度前拒绝重复输出、嵌套输出，以及不同 `cwd` 之间的输出目录包含关系   （退出码 2，不启动 agent）；显式提供 `run_parallel(waves=...)` 时，仅允许同一波次   无冲突，并在波次之间设置屏障。  ### 2.3 工程质量验证  声明式验证器注册表（像 `engineering.yaml` 之于 `cli.py`）：  ```yaml # pi-batch.yaml（当前共 24 个；以下为核心示例） validators:   quick: \\\"python cli.py check\\\"   gofmt: 'test -z \\\"$(gofmt -l {output})\\\"'   build: \\\"go build ./... && go vet ./...\\\"   config: \\\"python cli.py config-validate\\\"   root: \\\"python cli.py check-root\\\"   pyquality: \\\"python {cwd}/quality.py {cwd}\\\" ```  - `--validate quick,gofmt`：命名引用，AND 语义（全部通过才落盘）；文件级   validator 最多 4 路并行执行并按声明顺序裁决，仓库级 validator 延后到阶段末 - `validate: jsonschema=schemas/result.schema.json`：结构化产物按声明 schema   机械校验；同样参与重试反馈、零残留拒绝和 `--reuse` 复验 - **每阶段可选**：任务 `validate` > 阶段 `validate_cmd` > CLI > 无；   空字符串显式禁用（分析类任务跳过，代码生成类保留） - 机制：输出写临时文件（`{output}` 占位符）→ 验证命令 → 通过则原子   rename，失败则删除零残留；`{tool_root}` 占位符展开为工具仓库根   （validator/stage 命令可引用随仓库分发的脚本，替代硬编码绝对路径，   sverp 实战反馈） - 外部验证器 stdout/stderr 分别受 `validation.output_max_bytes`（默认 256KiB）   约束；超限按验证失败关闭，避免 noisy gate 在超时前耗尽 runner 内存 - stage `commands` 同样使用进程组硬截止与有界诊断；全局默认由   `commands.timeout/output_max_bytes` 控制，阶段可用   `command_timeout/command_output_max_bytes` 覆盖  ### 2.4 断点续跑与 7×24  | 参数 | 作用 | |---|---| | `--reuse` | 当前 validator 复验已有输出；通过才复用，stage `commands` 仍重跑；**gate 阶段例外**——含 `VERDICT: FAIL/REJECT`（或无裁决）的产物永不复用（裁决绑定仓库状态，fingerprint 看不见代码变化；修复后被拒 gate 会被删除并重审，PASS 裁决复用会显式告警），aero-id 维护 R5e 复盘修复 | | `--retries N` | 任务失败自动重试，指数退避；速率/网络类至少等 30s | | `--max-rounds N`（0=无限） | 轮循环直到全部通过，`--round-delay` 轮间休息 | | `--min-interval` | 成功任务间节流 | | `--log-file` | 时间戳日志落盘（配合 `tail -f`/systemd 监控） | | `--stream-output auto|full|none` | 模型正文实时展示策略；默认仅 TTY 展示 |  配套：`run-review.py --all --resume` 从磁盘输出续跑并接力链上下文；已有阶段会先 经过本次命令指定的 validator，失效产物自动重新生成。  运行日志与 message 分层管理：`--log-file` 只记录生命周期、重试、验证和 Gate 等运营元数据；完整模型正文保留在任务产物和 agent 原生会话中。 `auto` 在 nohup/CI/systemd 等非 TTY 场景不实时复制正文，`full`/`none` 可显式 覆盖。无 `output` 的单问答仍会在任务结束时把最终答案输出一次。Campaign 隔离流水线由子进程的轮转 handler 单独写日志，避免同一路径双写和轮转竞争。  ### 2.5 会话模式  ```bash --session-mode new        # 默认：每次调用新会话 --session-mode shared     # 整个批次/流水线一个会话（后续步骤延续上下文） --session-mode per-stage  # 流水线每阶段一个会话 ```  - 标志来自 `pi-batch.yaml` `agent.session_flags`（pi 风格默认，可适配其他 CLI） - 共享会话要求串行（并行会乱序，runner 拒绝该组合） - 会话 id 由 `--session-name` 派生（可重现）→ 断点续跑延续同一会话  ### 2.5.1 渐进式 Message Memory  Pi 原始 JSONL message 保持不变；runner 为新任务分配可追踪的 session id，并把 任务、验证器、Gate、C [evidence truncated: showing 23566 of 57183 bytes; full artifact: /home/u1/ai-batch-runner/AGENTS.md] </evidence>  <evidence source=\\\"SPEC_SYSTEM\\\"> # 规范体系总览（Spec System Map）  本仓库是一套 **AI 软件工程决策操作系统**：把资深工程师经验编码为 分层规范 + 算法匹配 + 机器门禁 + 对抗审查 + 经验沉淀闭环。规范库很大， 但单次任务注入量始终有界（scale × page_type × risk 分级处方）。  ## 1. 规范资产分层  | 层 | 目录 | 内容 | |---|---|---| | 前端视觉 | `ui-specs/` | spacing（8pt token）/ component / layout-patterns / anti-patterns / business-profiles×7（erp/cms/oa/dashboard/immersive/marketing/mobile） | | 前端工程 | `ui-specs/engineering/` | async-data（防抖/竞态/幂等决策表）、form-table-state、interaction-patterns、error-recovery、architecture-budgets、defect-patterns（12 事故档案） | | 后端架构 | `backend-specs/` | architecture / design-patterns（决策表+过度设计红线）/ domain-modeling / evolution / oop-and-di / ddd（分级）/ algorithms-data-structures / complexity-and-scale / persistence-modeling（强制关卡）/ production-readiness / agent-guardrails / architecture-constitution / testing / system-engineering / network-engineering | | 产品思维 | `product-specs/` | product-thinking（L0-L3 分级+推演链）/ commercial-readiness（低成本预留vs高成本实现）/ open-source-readiness / completion-evidence（证据报告） | | 项目知识 | `docs/agent-context/` | context-map.yaml（路径/关键词 → ADR/契约/安全基线路由） |  ## 2. 规则注册表（算法消费）  | 注册表 | 域 | 轴 | |---|---|---| | `ui-specs/rules.yaml` | 前端 | scale（demo<standard<production）× page_type（form/table/detail/workbench/immersive/auth）× risk | | `backend-specs/rules.yaml` | 后端 | 同上（use_case_types：crud/workflow/integration/query + 算法场景 search/sort/graph/schedule/cache/range）| | `product-specs/rules.yaml` | 产品 | scale × use_case_type（auth/upload/approval/messaging/erp/search/billing）× risk；L0 克制不加载（domain_for 仅对 productization_level L1+ 路由到 product 域）；L1=demo/L2=standard/L3=production（product_manifest specs 派生）|  路由优先级：classifier 先行——同时含产品信号与前端/后端信号的任务（如“做一个 SaaS 计费前端页面”）取 backend/frontend_ui 注册表而非 product；产品规范仍经 `assess` 的 `product_manifest`（按 level 驱动、与域无关）到达。  每条规则：`id / description / files / min_tier / page_types / risk / required_when_risk / profiles`。`pi-batch rules --check` 校验 schema； 规则不得引用注册表文件自身——自引用 `files`/`files_template` 会被 `rules --check` 拒绝（fail closed）。  ## 3. 决策链（一次任务如何被处理）  ``` 需求文本  ├─ classify      判域：frontend_ui / backend / analysis / ...  ├─ rules         算法匹配规则 manifest（scale×page_type×risk）+ LLM 双向校验  │                 （REQUIRED 规则不可被 LLM 跳过；增补带 provenance）  ├─ assess        需求评估：8 维完整性 / 规模 S-M-L / 产品化 L0-L3 /  │                 工作流 L0-L3（建议可执行流水线文件）  ├─ context       项目文档路由（路径 glob + 关键词 → ADR/契约）  ├─ 流水线        plan（含强制设计关卡）→ implement（机器门禁+证据报告）  │                 → meta 对抗审查（34+ 角色）→ VERDICT 裁决  └─ 完成          completion_report（commands executed vs not_executed） ```  ## 4. 机器门禁（可确定检查的绝不靠自觉）  | 门禁 | 检查 | 验证器 | |---|---|---| | 前端 UI 规范 | 魔法间距/硬编码颜色/inline style/字号漂移（单产物+项目级） | uispacing/uicolor/uistyle/uifont/uicheck | | 前端工程 | console.log/any/不安全 html/空 catch/测试 skip（恒失败）；上帝文件/复杂度/useEffect 泄漏/循环 await（strict） | uiquality | | 后端工程 | 浮点金额/SELECT */无租户查询/LIKE 全扫/危险 DDL/状态直接赋值/domain→infra 依赖（恒失败或 strict） | backendquality | | 完成证据 | completion_report 结构/result 枚举/not_executed 带原因/禁伪造通过 | completion | | 实战规律（第四域） | 产品基线存在性（L1）/能力声明带契约出处（L2）/证据纪律（L7）/明确不做碰撞（L6）/变更预算（L9） | baseline/authority/evidence/nongoal/changebudget | | 秘密扫描 | api key/token 等 | secretscan | | 注册表 | 规则 schema/引用文件存在 | rules --check | | 规则回归 | 42 个 eval 断言（classify/rules/assess 行为） | make eval / CI |  ## 5. 角色库（meta 编排动态挑选，34+）  前端：ui_designer / ui_reviewer / visual_reviewer / frontend_engineer / async_reviewer / code_architecture_reviewer 后端：backend_engineer / design_pattern_reviewer / algorithm_reviewer / testing_reviewer / architecture_constitution_reviewer / architect / ... 产品：product_thinker 通用：security_engineer / qa_lead / pm / cto / ...  ## 6. 经验沉淀闭环（Evolution Engineering）  ``` 事故/审查发现  → pi-batch learn（--from-memory 可从消息记忆取失败）  → docs/rules/drafts/*.yaml（统一 Rule Schema，人工批准门槛）  → 并入域注册表 rules.yaml（evolution 域 promote 强制 samples/confidence）  → 匹配器/门禁/审查角色下次自动消费  → pi-batch eval 防回归（改关键词/规则破坏行为 → make ci 失败） ```  ### 第四域：实战规律（evolution-specs/rules.yaml）  归纳自 snaplink-console（契约驱动高风险控制台）与 iris-ui（四框架平台库） 两个真实项目的实战轨迹（docs/ 下的基线/决策/门禁/复盘文件）。规律按 **形态分类 × 反例信号 × 分级**路由（pbatch/evolution.py）：  - **分级**：invariant（安全底线，不可豁免）/ contract-policy（默认强制，   宪法可豁免）/ suggestion（只注入不拦截） - **探索豁免**：spike/原型任务自动降级非 invariant 规律（创新不被锁死） - **项目宪法**：`docs/evolution/constitution.yaml`（明确不做/变更预算/   豁免留痕 90 天复查）；campaign 方向撞明确不做 fail closed - **验证优先**：pipeline `verify_experiment` 阶段（L4 真实运行验证，   失败即阶段失败）  ```bash pi-batch evolution apply \\\"任务\\\"       # 形态分类 + 规律适用清单 pi-batch evolution route \\\"任务\\\"       # 管线形状推荐（风险×产品化×预算） pi-batch evolution init|check|report  # 宪法生成/门禁/规律报告 pi-batch evolution override --rule X --reason \\\"...\\\"  # 豁免留痕 pi-batch learn ... --registry evolution  # 实战事故→规律（强制 samples） ```  ## 7. 克制原则（整个体系的纪律）  - 小 demo（L0/scale S）只加载视觉核心 2 条规则；生产级才全套 - 处方档 = min(关键词档, 规模档)——\\\"企业登录页\\\"不因\\\"企业\\\"二字全量上规则 - 无商业信号不设计 Billing；无开源意图不生成开源文档；无第二使用方不抽象 - 推演出的隐含需求是\\\"待确认问题\\\"，未经确认禁止实现 - 每次规则选择都有证据与 provenance，可审计 # ai-batch-runner  An interactive terminal workbench and governed batch/pipeline runtime for **any CLI-based coding agent** — local-first and not tied to one vendor. Point it at `pi`, [Claude Code](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code), Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, OpenCode, or configure `agent.argument_flags` for another argv contract. The built-in adapter accepts:  ---  ## 快速开始（产品 CLI）  ```bash pipx install ai-batch-runner       # 推荐：隔离安装正式版本 # 或：uv tool install ai-batch-runner / pip install ai-batch-runner pi-batch                  # 默认产品入口：交互式 TUI（真实终端） pi-batch doctor           # 环境诊断：安装/目录/配置/agent/密钥/锁 pi-batch init             # 创建用户级工作目录骨架 pi-batch version          # 版本 + 环境 pi-batch -p \\\"写一个订单接口，含支付审批，生产，go\\\" --classify   # 一句话 → 全流程 pi-batch completion bash >> ~/.bashrc    # shell 补全（zsh 同理） ```  从源码开发安装使用 `pip install -e \\\".[dev]\\\"`。维护者发布流程见 [`docs/RELEASING.md`](docs/RELEASING.md)。  构建 wheel 安装时会同时携带规则注册表、验证脚本、默认流水线、角色模板和 评估集；`pi-batch health --json` 会检查分发资产是否完整。  ### 用户级工作目录（XDG 兼容）  | 目录 | 用途 | |---|---| | `~/.config/pbatch/settings.yaml` | 用户配置（跨项目偏好） | | `~/.cache/pbatch/` | 可丢弃缓存 | | `~/.local/share/pbatch/keys/` | 设备身份密钥（跨项目复用） | | `~/.local/share/pbatch/logs/` | 全局运行日志 |  `PBATCH_HOME=~/.pbatch` 可统一收拢三目录。**配置分层**： CLI 参数 > 项目 `pi-batch.yaml` > 用户 settings.yaml > 内置默认。 项目相关状态（会话/记忆/被拒产物）保留在项目内 `.pi-batch/`——随仓库共享。  配置变更建议先做只读核验：  ```bash pi-batch config explain       # 来源、覆盖关系、脱敏后的最终配置与运行时值 pi-batch config check         # 版本/结构校验，适合 CI pi-batch config check --file pi-batch.yaml --json ```  `pi-batch.yaml` 使用 `config_version: 1`。缺省版本按 legacy v0 兼容；高于当前支持版本 会 fail closed。`config explain` 不创建目录、不启动 agent；报告中的敏感键（token、password、 private key 等）只显示 `<redacted>`。  ### 功能全景  - **50+ 子命令**：需求评估（assess/classify/profile/probe）→ 流程编排   （campaign/org/advance/race/pareto）→ 规则知识（rules/learn/adr/context/   memory/capsule/replay）→ 治理（truth/causal/temporal/pinned/metrics/   budget/recovery/events/world）→ 设备织网（devices/serve/runner）→ **实战规律   （evolution：形态分类/规律分级路由/项目宪法/管线形状推荐）** - **1086+ 回归测试 + 42 eval 用例**；`pi-batch check` 8 门禁聚合自检 - 零 LLM 确定性核心：所有检测/路由/校验纯 stdlib + ast，可测试、fail closed - 详见 `docs/`（AADM 理论四卷、AGENT_ORGANIZATION、CAMPAIGN_LESSONS）与 `AGENTS.md`  ``` <bin> -p PROMPT [--model M] [--provider P] [--thinking T] [--tools T] [--exclude-tools T] ```  and it will run one prompt, a batch of prompts (serial or parallel), or a multi-stage pipeline against it, with per-task output capture, engineering validation gates, session reuse, exponential-backoff retries, and optional auto git-commit after each stage.  > **Provenance**: this tree is a sync of `snaplink/ai-dev` (the living monorepo copy), carried > over as-is including its regression test suite. The engine now lives in the `pbatch/` > package with `pi-batch.py` as a thin entry shim (the reference's current layout; the > earlier 4-file split and the 1389-line monolith were both superseded). `tests/` > is the authoritative behavior spec. > > **Local adaptations** (everything else stays byte-identical): `pi-batch.yaml` > `validators.pyquality` points at `{cwd}/quality.py` (reference used an `ai-dev/` > prefix from snaplink's repo layout); **all `ai-dev/` path prefixes were stripped > from commands, prompts, docs and code comments** — this repo's root IS the > `ai-dev` content, so `python ai-dev/pi-batch.py` → `python pi-batch.py`, > `ai-dev/prompts` → `prompts`; upstream's `make ai-dev-test` → this repo's > `make ci`. Only historical upstream-name mentions (`snaplink/ai-dev`) remain. > > **Local fixes** (self-iteration round 1, driven by the meta-review pipeline in > `docs/self-iteration.yaml` — see `docs/reviews/`): > - `Task.output_path()` resolves relative outputs against `task.cwd` (was: process cwd); >   `_filter_reused` follows suit (`pbatch/models.py`, `pbatch/cli.py`) > - `_git_commit_stage` and single-batch git commit check exit codes and log real failures >   (`pbatch/pipeline.py`, `pbatch/cli.py`) > - `load_tasks` fails loud when PyYAML is missing for a `.yaml`/`tasks:` file >   (`pbatch/pipeline.py`) > - `save_result` writes atomically (tmp+rename) on the no-validator path too >   (`pbatch/runner.py`) > - `git-auto-commit.sh`: protected-branch guard + sensitive-file exclusions > - tests: `tests/test_local_fixes.py` (10 cases); config-resolution tests run with a >   clean env (`PBATCH_SCRIPT_DIR` can no longer hijack them) > > **Local fixes** (self-iteration round 2): > - F1: `from_dir` constructors emit absolute output paths — the round-1 cwd-aware >   `output_path()` otherwise double-prefixed them (`docs/inputs/docs/inputs/...`) > - P0-1: stage outputs, meta role outputs and single-batch git-commit inputs now >   propagate **resolved** paths (`output_path()`), so git add / `_combine_outputs` / >   archiving / decision logs can no longer operate on decoy process-cwd files > - F2: `run_task` and `ai/run-review.py::_run_agent` kill the child process group on >   ANY abnormal exit (Ctrl-C/SIGTERM included) — no more orphaned agents > - F3/F14: validator `{output}`/`{cwd}` substitutions are shell-quoted; temp files use >   unique mkstemp names; validators run in their own process group with a killable >   timeout (`_run_validator`) > - F5: task log lines show the prompt truncated to 80 chars (prompt content no longer >   shipped verbatim by `--log-file`) > - F9: stdin is consumed once before the round loop — `--max-rounds` no longer dies >   with \\\"Provide a prompt\\\" on round 2+ for stdin batches > - F12: gate verdict regex is line-anchored (`^\\\\s*VERDICT\\\\s*:`) — prose mentions no >   longer unlock a gate > - `.coverage` tolerated by root-policy and gitignored; Makefile/docs test counts >   refreshed > - tests: 9 more cases in `tests/test_local_fixes.py` (19 total) > > **Local fixes** (full-SDLC pipeline round, T1/T2 per `docs/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN_T0_CLOSEOUT.md`): > - T1 `pbatch/reuse.py::reuse_decision()`: reuse requires exists ∧ non-empty ∧ not-symlink >   ∧ all effective validators still pass; stale artifacts are deleted for regeneration; >   all six reuse sites wired; `--reuse-legacy` escape hatch > - T2: `TaskResult` additive validation fields; validator stderr (capped 4000/40) + exit >   flow into the retry prompt; each event carries >   `schema_version`, `event_id`, `run_id`, `task_id`, `stage_id`, `attempt` >   and `phase`; `--run-id` can supply an external correlation id; `--webhook` >   non-blocking delivery; `SUMMARY.md` is >   regenerated from it. Input fingerprints make `--reuse`/`--skip-passed` >   freshness-aware instead of trusting a non-empty Markdown file. > - analysis parallelism stays inside the lock-owning process. Parallel >   implementation uses one Git worktree, branch, output tree, decision log, >   and run log per direction. > - meta stages score role templates with `pbatch/role_keywords.yaml`, inject >   matched-keyword evidence, deduplicate the model plan, and enforce >   `max_roles_per_iteration` at runtime.  ## Switching agents  The agent binary is a config value, not a hardcoded dependency — edit `agent.bin` in `pi-batch.yaml`, or pass `--agent-bin` on the command line:  ```yaml # pi-batch.yaml agent:   bin: pi              # or: claude, codex, gemini, opencode, ...   default_model: \\\"\\\"   default_timeout: 300   default_workers: 4   argument_flags:          # per-agent overrides are also supported     prompt: \\\"-p\\\"           # use \\\"\\\" for a positional prompt     model: \\\"--model\\\" ```  Before a non-dry run starts, the CLI checks that the selected executable is available. Project validators use `project.frontend_root`, `backend_root`, and `report_root`; relative values resolve against the task working directory. Regular wheel installs also carry the default pipelines, role prompts, rule registries, eval suites and checker scripts. Project-local assets take precedence; installed assets are the fallback, so `pi-batch rules`, `eval`, `check`, `campaign`, and classifier routing work outside this checkout. `pi-batch health` is also runnable from a wheel, but its default self-check honestly reports unhealthy when the wheel has no source tests (tests are not shipped); use `pi-batch health --dir /path/to/project` to assess a target project.  Configuration sections are type-checked at startup. Malformed section/value types are reported and replaced with bounded built-in defaults, so a typo does not crash the long-running coordinator during module import.  ```bash python pi-batch.py tasks.yaml --agent-bin claude --mode parallel --workers 4 python pi-batch.py tasks.yaml --agent-bin codex  --mode serial ```  ## Quick start  ```bash # Install as a global CLI command (like pi/codex), then use it anywhere: pipx install ai-batch-runner # or: uv tool install / pip install pi-batch                    # interactive TUI on a real terminal pi-batch tui                # explicit TUI entry pi-batch -p \\\"analyze this project\\\" -o output.md python -m pbatch ...        # same entry, no install needed python pi-batch.py ...      # zero-install fallback from the repo root  # Task type classifier: decide BEFORE execution whether a task is frontend UI pi-batch classify \\\"用 Flutter 实现 ERP 排程列表页\\\" pi-batch classify tasks.yaml --json        # machine-readable  # Requirement assessment: prescription + productization + workflow level pi-batch assess \\\"企业订单管理：新建订单表单，含支付审批流程\\\" pi-batch assess --file requirements.md     # from a document pi-batch assess \\\"...\\\" --prompt             # compiled instruction block for the agent pi-batch assess \\\"...\\\" --json  # Rule matching (scale × page_type × risk) + two-sided LLM check pi-batch rules \\\"生成一个登录页 demo\\\" pi-batch rules --check                     # registry schema integrity (three domains) pi-batch rules \\\"...\\\" --summary | --llm-prompt p.txt | --llm-json '{...}'  # Context routing + evolution + self-check pi-batch context \\\"任务\\\" --paths src/order/**   # project documents for a task pi-batch learn \\\"订单并发创建重复记录\\\"            # RCA -> rule draft (--from-memory TERM) pi-batch eval                                  # rule-system regression suite (42 cases) pi-batch check                                 # one-command self-check pi-batch tasks.yaml --validate 'jsonschema=schemas/result.schema.json'  # Frontend task: --classify routes it to the frontend implementation # pipeline (real code in the project; plan -> implement with # uiquality/uicheck/completion gates -> adversarial review -> verdict) # (classifier.frontend_pipeline), which applies ui-specs + UI validators # (uispacing/uicolor/uistyle/uifont) + meta UI review + verdict gate pi-batch -p \\\"生成一个登录页面 tsx\\\" --classify --dry-run  # Batch from a YAML task file pi-batch tasks.yaml --mode parallel --workers 4  # Multi-stage pipeline (chained roles, e.g. architect -> tech-lead -> implementer -> qa -> security) pi-batch --pipeline pipelines/pipeline-code-impl.yaml  # 24x7 loop: rerun failed tasks until everything passes pi-batch tasks.yaml --max-rounds 0 --round-delay 60  # Repository campaign: inspect the plan, then analyze and implement Top N directions pi-batch campaign --dry-run pi-batch campaign --max-directions 2 --reuse --retry-failed ```  ### Interactive terminal UI  Running `pi-batch` without arguments opens the Textual workbench when both stdin and stdout are interactive terminals. Use **Ctrl+P** for the command palette, **Ctrl+N** for a new task, **Ctrl+L** to clear the transcript, **Ctrl+C** to cancel the active run, and **Ctrl+Q** to quit.  Slash commands are available from the prompt: `/help`, `/status`, `/new`, `/clear`, `/model`, `/provider`, `/agent`, `/memory`, `/doctor`, and `/quit`. `/help` shows the current syntax and state-dependent behavior. The full startup, trust-boundary, and release contract is documented in [`docs/TUI_PRODUCT.md`](docs/TUI_PRODUCT.md).  The automatic TUI never activates when either stdin or stdout is redirected, so existing scripts and CI remain headless-compatible. Piped prompts and all explicit batch/subcommands keep their original behavior:  ```bash printf 'analyze this repository\\\\n' | pi-batch pi-batch -p \\\"analyze this repository\\\" --stream-output none pi-batch tui --help ```  Example `tasks.yaml`:  ```yaml tasks:   - prompt: \\\"Analyze the project expansion directions\\\"     output: docs/expansion.md     model: claude-sonnet     cwd: /path/to/project    - prompt: \\\"Review security edge cases\\\"     output: docs/security-review.md     model: claude-sonnet:high     cwd: /path/to/project ```  ## Feature map  - **Task type classifier**: `--classify` + `pi-batch.py classify` subcommand run a   deterministic bilingual keyword gate BEFORE execution (zero LLM cost); a   frontend-dominated batch routes to the configured UI generation pipeline   (`classifier.frontend_pipeline`, default   `examples/frontend-implementation-pipeline.yaml`).   Keywords are additive-extensible via `pbatch/task_keywords.yaml`; platform   mention (tsx/dart/flutter/vue/react-native) boosts the frontend decision;   explicit `--pipeline` always wins; missing pipeline file fails loudly. - **Rule matcher** (`pi-batch rules`): the spec system is large, so a small demo   must not load all of it. `pbatch/rule_matcher.py` + `ui-specs/rules.yaml`   algorithmically select the applicable rules along three axes — scale   (demo < standard < production, default standard), page type (form/table/   detail/workbench/immersive/auth) and risk (high-risk pay/approve/delete   flows force error-recovery + defect-patterns). Output is a bounded manifest   (paths + why + skipped reasons); prompts inject ONLY the manifest and agents   load files on demand (progressive disclosure). - **Backend architecture governance** (`backend-specs/` + `backendquality`): the   same layered machinery now covers backend work — the classifier already   separates backend tasks, and the rule matcher/assessor pick the backend   registry automatically (`backend-specs/rules.yaml`, signals: use   cases/entities/integrations/distribution). Specs: architecture (module   organization by business capability, Transport → Application → Domain ←   Infrastructure dependency direction, data ownership, composition over   inheritance), design-patterns (pattern selection DECISION TABLE keyed on   problems, over-engineering red lines — no interface per class, no factory   per object, no BaseService/Manager soup, rule of three), domain-modeling   (state machines centralized, domain objects protect invariants, UoW at the   use-case boundary), evolution (refactor triggers, ADR, tech debt, migration   windows). Roles `backend_engineer`/`design_pattern_reviewer` (default   stance: every pattern is guilty until it proves it solves a real problem).   `backendquality` validator mechanically enforces over-engineering signals   (single-implementation interfaces, Base classes, fuzzy names), god-service   signals, scattered status assignment, domain→infrastructure imports, and   complexity signals (N+1 loops, full-sort Top K, O(n) shift queues);   `examples/backend-engineering-review.yaml` runs the audit loop. - **Computer science base** (`backend-specs/oop-and-di.md`, `ddd.md`,   `algorithms-data-structures.md`, `complexity-and-scale.md`): the backend   agent must judge object-vs-function, encapsulation (business-semantic   methods, never setter soup), IoC/DI lifecycle (constructor injection, no   Service Locator), AOP boundaries (never hide inventory/state/payment rules   in aspects), DDD with usage LEVELS (L0 transaction script → L3 full DDD,   never default full DDD), the data structure decision table (Map for key   lookups, Heap for Top K, Bloom Filter only for false-positive-tolerant   prefiltering), BFS/DFS choice, five cost classes (CPU/memory/database/   network/distributed coordination), and ×10/×100 scale reasoning. The   `algorithms` rule triggers only on search/sort/graph/schedule/cache/range   tasks; `ddd`/`complexity-scale` are production-tier. Roles include   `algorithm_reviewer` (default stance: every hot path is guilty of O(n²)/   N+1/scale blindness until proven otherwise). - **Persistence modeling gate** (`backend-specs/persistence-modeling.md`):   the data objects being persisted decide five to ten years of maintenance   cost, so persistence design is a MANDATORY pre-code gate: four models stay   separate (API DTO / Domain Model / Persistence Model / Read Model — never   return ORM entities), identity decision table (surrogate PK vs UUIDv7/ULID/   Snowflake vs business key vs idempotency key), money as minor-unit BIGINT   or DECIMAL (never float), time semantics, status codes with a central   state machine, snapshot fields for historical integrity, NULL semantics,   index design driven by access paths, database unique constraints as the   final idempotency line, audit/status-history tables, optimistic locking,   soft-delete trade-offs, and Expand–Migrate–Contract migrations. The   `backend_engineer` role must output a Persistence Design report (aggregate/   tables/identity/consistency/snapshots/concurrency/queries+indexes/history/   deletion/migration) before any table or ORM entity. - **Production readiness + guardrails** (`backend-specs/production-readiness.md`,   `agent-guardrails.md`): an 11-section readiness gate (requirement   correctness, contracts/events, stable error model, reliability per   dependency, capacity budgets with bounded pools, rate limiting/cache   consistency/message semantics/background jobs, multi-tenant scoping,   security & privacy, observability, five-layer testing with honest   verification reporting, graceful shutdown & migration windows) plus AI-   specific guardrails (no hallucinated APIs/results, change-radius control,   don't-DRY-away-boundaries, no perf claims without benchmarks). The   `backendquality` validator adds float-money, SELECT *, tenant-less WHERE   id, LIKE-% full scans, VARCHAR(255) sprawl, swallowed exceptions, per-request   HTTP clients and busy-polling loops to its strict warnings. - **Senior architecture constitution** (`backend-specs/architecture-constitution.md`):   architecture as change management — Change Amplification as the key metric,   decision reversibility register (PKs/public APIs/event formats/service   boundaries need evidence before commitment), organization fit & cognitive   load, modular monolith as the default (distributed-monolith is the anti-   pattern), unique data ownership with derived data marked, the coupling   octet (code/data/temporal/order/deployment/semantic/organizational/runtime),   blast radius & bulkheads, tail latency & queueing theory, retry budgets &   end-to-end timeout allocation, explicit consistency models (PACELC),   contract evolution with deprecation, delete-ability, designed manual   intervention, STRIDE threat modeling, TCO, architecture fitness functions   (automated gates), and the senior-architect 15 questions.   `architecture_constitution_reviewer` role audits the design against it   (production tier rule only). - **Testing & system engineering** (`backend-specs/testing.md`,   `system-engineering.md`, `network-engineering.md`): five-layer testing   (unit/integration/contract/E2E/non-functional) with reproduce-first bug   fixing, risk coverage instead of line coverage, property/fuzz testing,   and honest verification (no assertion-less te [evidence truncated: showing 23565 of 44955 bytes; full artifact: /home/u1/ai-batch-runner/README.md] </evidence>  <evidence source=\\\"CHECKS_REGISTRY\\\"> # CHECKS_REGISTRY — ai-batch-runner 工程门禁注册表  本仓库的工程质量门禁体系仿照 `snaplink` 的质量管理（`cli.py` + `checks/` + `engineering.yaml` + `make ci` + git hooks + CI），针对 Python 项目做了适配。 核心原则与 snaplink 一致：  1. **零依赖可移植**：门禁只用标准库（ast/unittest），复制 `cli.py` +    `checks/` + `engineering.yaml` 到任意 Python 项目即可复用，只改 YAML 配置。 2. **门禁约束自研代码**：与上游 `snaplink/ai-dev` 同步的引擎文件    （`pi-batch.py`、`ai/run-review.py`）通过 `engineering.yaml` 的    `ignore_patterns` 豁免——质量规则只约束我们自主编写的代码。 3. **门禁自身有单测**（`checks/test_*.py`，`make self-test`）：检查器坏了    必须能被发现。  ## 门禁清单  | 门禁 | 命令 | 阈值 | 说明 | |---|---|---|---| | G1 filesize | `make check-filesize` | 500 行/文件 | 源文件行数预算；豁免清单（`exemptions`）只减不增 | | G2 complexity | `make check-complexity` | 圈复杂度 15 / 认知复杂度 20（每函数） | ast 实现，替代 gocyclo/gocognit | | G3 root policy | `make check-root` | 根目录 ≤16 文件 | 根目录只允许配置/入口/文档；禁止 `*_test.py` 散落根目录 | | G4 style | `make check-style` | 行宽 100（警告） | 行尾空白、tab 缩进、缺末尾换行、非 utf-8 为硬失败 | | G5 quality | `make quality` | 函数 50 行 / 圈复杂度 15 / 文件 1000 行 / 重复函数体 | 参考版自带扫描器 `quality.py`（纯 stdlib），经 `pi-batch.yaml` 注册为 `validators.pyquality` | | H0 self-test | `make self-test` | — | 门禁自身单测（50 例，unittest 零依赖） | | T0 regression | `make test` | — | 引擎、规则系统/评估器/检查器与 Campaign 回归套件（pytest，需 dev extras） | | E0 eval | `make eval` | 42 项 | classify/rules/assess/product/workflow 行为回归 | | T1 coverage | `make coverage` | — | checks/ + cli.py 覆盖率报告（需 pytest-cov） |  ### Agent 结构化产物门禁  `jsonschema=<path>` 是任务/阶段级 validator，不默认加入本仓库 CI。它调用 `scripts/check-json-schema.py`，在产物原子落盘和 `--reuse` 复验前校验纯 JSON； 非法 JSON、未知约束关键字、外部 `$ref` 和 schema 不匹配均 fail closed。  ## 使用  ```bash make check          # G1-G4 零依赖门禁 make self-test      # H0 门禁自身单测 make quality        # G5 组织质量扫描（quality.py，上游同步） make test           # T0 回归套件（pip install -e \\\".[dev]\\\"） make ci             # G1-G5 + H0 + T0 + E0 + organization contracts python cli.py check-filesize   # 单独跑某门禁 ```  ## 配置（engineering.yaml）  各门禁阈值与豁免均在 `engineering.yaml` 中声明：  - `filesize.max_lines` / `ignore_patterns` / `exemptions` - `complexity.max_cyclomatic` / `max_cognitive` / `ignore_patterns` - `root_policy.max_files` / `allowed_files` / `banned_patterns` - `style.max_line_length` / `ignore_patterns`  `ignore_patterns` 为子串匹配（snaplink 语义）。新增业务代码必须通过全部门禁； 需要放宽阈值时先改 YAML 再提交，并在 commit message 中说明理由。  ## Git hooks  ```bash git config core.hooksPath .githooks ```  - `pre-commit`：对暂存的 `.py` 文件跑 filesize + style 门禁（豁免规则同上） - `pre-push`：跑 `cli.py harness`（= `make check` + `make self-test`）  ## 上游同步豁免  `pbatch/`（引擎包）、`pi-batch.py`（入口 shim）、`ai/run-review.py`、`quality.py` 均为与 `snaplink/ai-dev` 同步的上游文件，经 `engineering.yaml` 的 `ignore_patterns` 豁免（这些模块仍须通过 `quality.py` 的 1000 行预算； 参考版自带的行尾空白与复杂度超过本仓库更严预算的少数函数一并豁免）。 质量规则实际约束自研代码：`checks/`、`cli.py`、`Makefile` 及新增业务代码。  ## CI
